revisions.text: The seventh moon is counting on you, Yamato. Don't let them down.
Kaori, you honor your brother by taking his name, and honor him further still by making his dreams a reality. Summon me.

Kaori.  You honor your brother by taking his name… and honor him further still by making his dreams a reality.  Complete the ritual and see the success you both dreamed of.
